notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Memnite, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Forest.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If desired, once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite {C}, and then you may forego tapping or sacrificing them on future iterations to get infinite creature tokens.
